text:
Sam (oncall lead): Quick coordination — we've had two overnight P1s and EMEA requests. Proposing we shift next week's daily triage bridge 09:30 -> 08:30 PT (so it hits 16:30 UTC) to give EMEA a slightly earlier handoff window. Also want a tightened 15-min agenda to speed decisions.
Maya: Sounds reasonable. EMEA folks asked for earlier. 08:30 PT works for me. :+1:
Devon: I can do 08:30 PT Mon-Fri next week. Can we keep the bridge to 15 min and only escalate anything still open after that to the async doc?
Sam (oncall lead): Yes — that's the plan. Proposed 15-min agenda below. If nothing critical, we close and move follow-ups to the incident thread.
Priya: Quick note — I'm the escalation on-call Wed-Fri next week, so I'll be on bridge for those days. If we move earlier, pls ping me on pager for any mid-bridge role swaps.
Sam (oncall lead): Noted. Raj, can you confirm whether you can make 08:30 PT Tue/Thu? If not, we can rotate coverage.
Raj: Tue/Thu are rough for me (calendar conflict). I can do Mon/Wed/Fri. If I'm out, I'll post a 1-paragraph async handoff in #incidents before bridge.
Ellen: Can we add a short check of queued alerts at start? 2m quick scan to avoid surprise pages.
Devon: +1 to the queued alerts check. Also propose we toggle auto-escalation window to 10m for the bridge period (so pages get routed if bridge hasn't closed). Ops team ok with that?
InfraBot: [automated] Auto-escalation policy change request received: target window 10m during configured bridge. Pending approval by infra-sre.
Maya: Agree to auto-escalation 10m for Next Week trial. If we get noise, we revert.
Sam (oncall lead): Agenda (15 min):
```
1) Quick rollcall (name + timezone) - 1m
2) 2m queued alerts scan
3) Active incidents (<5m summary each) - 8m total
4) Decision + owner assignment - 3m
5) Async follow-ups & docs - 1m
```
Sam (oncall lead): Calendar invite text I just drafted — copy/paste into calendar: "Daily Triage Bridge (trial time) Mon-Fri 08:30 PT / 16:30 UTC — 15 min. Purpose: quick rollcall, scan queued alerts, triage active incidents, assign owners. If incident requires >15m, move to incident channel and schedule follow-up call"
Priya: One operational ask — can we require each oncall to update the incident doc key fields before joining (severity, owner, blameless notes)? Saves time.
Devon: Agreed. Suggest a minimum template line items: title, sev, pager, owner, short impact. We can add as a checklist in the incident doc.
Sam (oncall lead): I'll add the checklist to the incident tracker and post a link in the invite.
Raj: If I can't make a bridge, I'll leave my async note with "current action" + "blocked on" + links. That should be good enough.
Maya: Cool. Who needs to be mandatory? I'm thinking SRE rotation + infra lead + product-oncall for any customer-impacting sev2+.
Ellen: For sev1/2, product-oncall mandatory. For sev3 we do opt-in unless it affects SLAs.
Sam (oncall lead): Final ask — please RSVP on the calendar. If you can't attend, post the async handoff before the bridge. We'll run the trial next Mon-Fri. I'll send a summary after Friday with metrics (incidents handled, avg bridge time).
Devon: I'll monitor metrics. Will log avg duration and number of escalations.
Priya: I can take notes Wed-Fri.
Maya: Thx. I'll update the invite + incident checklist now.
Sam (oncall lead): Thanks team. If no objections by EOD PT today, I'll update the rota and push the invite. :rocket:
